question: Which type of divine presence is ranked superior for worship?
premises: A divine presence from a group is considered best
A self-born divine presence is compared to it
The self-born presence is declared excellent
inference: The self-born divine presence is superior to one derived from a group.

plain_english: A divine presence from a group is good, but a self-born one is even better.
